Loyal,Ⓒa.ⒹBakta, anurakta, dfQaBakti, Baktiyukta-mat, sAnurAga, Asakta; ‘l(oyal) to the king’ nfpAnurakta, praBuBaktinizWa, rAjAjYAnuvartin, nfpAsakta; ‘a l(oyal) wife’ satI, sADvI, pativratA, ekapatnI, sucaritrA, ‘l(oyal) husband’ svadAranirataH, BAryAnuraktaH.
Ⓝ[Loyal]ly,Ⓒadv.ⒹBakti pUrvaM, sAnurAgaM, dfQaBaktipUrvaM, rAjanizWApUrvaM.
Ⓝ[Loyal]ty,Ⓒs.ⒹBakti f., anurAgaH, Asakti f., praBu-svAmi-BaktiH, rAjaBaktiH-anurAgaH, dfQaBaktiH, rAjanizWA; (in a wife) pAtivratyaM, satItvaM, &c.
